title: Launcher Subsystem Static Attributes
description: Static attributes of the launcher subsystem, containing configuration for barrel, breech, and capacitor modules.

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference path, used for editor intelligent suggestions and validation

basic_durability.description: Subsystem basic durability. Becomes paralyzed at 0, restores functionality when repaired to 30%.

pass_damage.description: Whether to pass damage to the subsystem holder. If true, damage received by the subsystem is transferred to the part.

limit_damage.description: Whether to limit damage transfer to remaining durability. e.g. 40 damage, 20 remaining, only 20 transfers.

hidden.description: Whether to hide the subsystem in HUD, commonly used for non-functional parts that only provide damage differentiation.

control_inputs.description: Fire signal input channel list, ordered by priority (highest first).

ammo_inputs.description: Ammunition supply discovery channel list. Empty list means universal receive mode (accepts any channel signal).

on_destroyed.description: Sound event when the subsystem is destroyed.

on_activate.description: Sound event when the subsystem is activated.

dry_fire.description: Dry fire sound event (trigger pulled but no ammunition).

sounds.description: Launcher sound attributes, including basic sounds and dry fire sound.

durability_weight.description: Module durability weight. Total subsystem durability is distributed among modules proportionally to their weight.

decay_power.description: Barrel decay curve exponent. Higher values mean shallower initial performance degradation and steeper decline at low durability.

damaged_spread.description: Damage limit spread multiplier. Spread multiplier when durability approaches 0 but is not yet destroyed.

destroyed_spread.description: Destroyed spread multiplier. Spread multiplier when durability reaches 0 (cliff effect).

damaged_muzzle_velocity.description: Damage limit muzzle velocity multiplier. Velocity ratio when durability approaches 0 but is not yet destroyed.

destroyed_muzzle_velocity.description: Destroyed muzzle velocity multiplier. Velocity ratio when durability reaches 0.

velocity_multiplier.description: Velocity multiplier, applied first (determined by barrel length/rifling).

horizontal_accuracy_multiplier.description: Horizontal accuracy multiplier. 1.0 = no change from projectile's default horizontal accuracy.

vertical_accuracy_multiplier.description: Vertical accuracy multiplier. 1.0 = no change from projectile's default vertical accuracy.

barrel.description: Barrel module attributes - defines baseline accuracy, muzzle velocity, and damage/destroyed decay.

durability_weight.description: Module durability weight. Total subsystem durability is distributed among modules proportionally to their weight.

recoil_absorption.description: Recoil absorption rate. 0.0 = full recoil, 1.0 = fully absorbed.

required_tags.description: Ammunition tags that must all be present. Empty list means no requirement.

acceptable_tags.description: Ammunition tags where at least one must be present. Empty list means any is accepted.

forbidden_tags.description: Ammunition tags that must not be present. Empty list means no restriction.

breech.description: Breech module attributes - defines fire rate, recoil absorption, and ammunition compatibility constraints.

durability_weight.description: Module durability weight. Total subsystem durability is distributed among modules proportionally to their weight.

capacitor.description: Capacitor module attributes (optional, used for railgun-style charge weapons).

examples.description: Minimal example - required fields only, uses all defaults
